QuestInfo.name: Feline Discourse
QuestInfo.0: Where's this '#bBoss Kitty#k' that stole Sakura's Orange Marble?
QuestInfo.1: The #bBoss Kitty#k has some kind of crazy cat accent or something. You can't understand a word of what it's saying. Maybe #bFraidy Cat#k can give you some language lessons.

yes.0: Was that Boss Kitty you were just talking to? I'll bet you didn't understand a word he said. How about I teach you some of the local cat dialect?
